get_random_tip: get a random CLI tip string from the Hermes agent tip corpus to display at session start
get_random_tip_exclude_recent: get a random CLI tip string from the Hermes agent while reserving exclude_recent for future deduplication
get_random_tip_usage: get a random tip about slash commands, keybindings, CLI flags, or configuration from the TIPS list
get_random_tip_config: get a random tip about configuration options like display settings, compression thresholds, or approval modes
get_random_tip_tools: get a random tip about Hermes agent tools like execute_code, delegate_task, browser_vision, or patch
